title: Sebze Olmak İsteyen Domates
author: Esat Zorkirişçi
description: Tomato has a big secret: he is not actually a vegetable but a fruit. His discovery begins an unexpected adventure in the magical Land of Refrigerator with Cucumber, Half-Lemon, and a group of brave friends. Together they face the Great Pasta Monster and question everything they have been told about who they are. With help from the Council of Elder Olives, they learn that what truly matters is not what others call you, but how you feel inside.
english_title: Tomato Wants To Be a Vegetable
